acceptanceMeaning: Independent acceptance of the frozen offline proposal and stated local evidence. It may be presented to the owner for the exact new protocol-amendment decision. It is not an owner approval, live admission, installation, lease, LOGIN, environment release or paid execution authorisation.
sourceReview: Original installed RPC body exactly matches the accepted frozen source and retained owner observation:14707 bytes. Proposed RPC body is identical except the one per-permit-expiry expression; original scope expiry, admitted-at checks, revocation, identity, ordinal, cap, at-most-once claims/submissions and late bookkeeping are preserved.

The new lease table is additive and fixed to this exact d002 case/attempt; its primary/unique constraints and immutable UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE guards prevent a second lease or renewal. Original scope/permit/pins/history and old triggers are not rewritten or disabled.

Grant validation uses the accepted aggregate-locking original-history check, exact physical owner, entire typed original scope/permit and d001 witnesses, all18 request pins, current prior receipt digest, one prior account, no d002 activity, no unknown outcomes/stops/relevant revocations, and inactive restricted runner with no sessions. Grant time is database-assigned and its deadline cannot exceed60 minutes or original scope expiry.

No-activity is checked at grant. The same current lease remains usable after the legitimate first claim. Lookup compares full original witnesses and prior evidence and fails explicitly false for missing/mismatched evidence; the RPC expression independently coalesces false so SQL NULL cannot reopen an expired permit.

Owner authority is a new separately recorded canonical amendment with an exact affirmative prompt, affirmative recorded response, both hashes and timestamps, exact proposal/target and comment-body hash. Old/proposed/declined/comment-only/null authority is rejected. Real owner consent still must be verified by root from the actual conversation and official comment; synthetic fixtures are not authority.

Materializer composes one transaction containing local bindings, additive schema, exact RPC replacement, postimage/attribute checks and validated initial lease INSERT. A rejected grant rolls back the schema/RPC changes. No operational standalone-install CLI is supplied.

New activation and reconciliation variants preserve the expired original permit, bind the separately observed lease/protocol and bound LOGIN inside that lease and original scope. Terminal audit checks claim/submission times to microsecond precision while allowing legitimate later receipt/accounting timestamps.

Generated root-only opener verifies all three frozen recovery source hashes before dynamic import, then validates the exact lease/protocol before private-key access. Accepted archive/authentication/raw retention behavior remains intact; the actual altered-module initializer control was rejected before import.

resolvedFindings.finding: Expired permit has no accepted renewal path.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Preserved as immutable history. The candidate is an explicit new owner-reviewable protocol amendment, with default authority HOLD.

resolvedFindings.finding: SQL NULL could otherwise skip an expiry or approval denial.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Lookup returns/coalesces false; required authority timestamps and fields reject absent/JSON-null values. Actual SQL negatives pass.

resolvedFindings.finding: Hash and target markers alone could misclassify a proposed or rejection question as approval.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Builder and database require one exact affirmative prompt and approved canonical decision/body. A reverse rejection question plus Yes with recomputed matching hashes is rejected.

resolvedFindings.finding: Recovery module initializer could run before its source bytes were checked.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Generated opener embeds all three approved source hashes and verifies them before importing the module. Actual tampered initializer stayed unexecuted.

resolvedFindings.finding: Presentation prompt had one trailing LF unlike the authority-bound prompt.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Final request artifact is exactly606 bytes without LF and equals the canonical rendered request. Source/proposal hash unchanged.

materialization.scope: Offline source-delta, authority, freshness, bounds, activation/audit and actual generated-opener pre-import tamper controls.

actualSql.engine: PostgreSQL 18.6 (PGlite 0.5.10) on wasm32-unknown-emscripten, compiled by emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 6.0.5 (1db513782be24469589d7cb8a1f1834e9a33f271), 32-bit
actualSql.scope: Actual accepted old/v2 SQL and proposed SQL, roles, real public RPC, generated PRE/POST/terminal queries, natural expiry and state transitions in disposable synthetic databases. Negative operations require database SQLSTATE errors; RPC/helpers are not mocked.

validation.independentVerification: Reviewer read source and test/fixture semantics, matched all frozen source/test/TAP/generated-file hashes, reconstructed the canonical proposal hash, compared installed/accepted/proposed RPC bodies, and parsed actual9+21 passing assertions and zero failure/skip/cancel summaries. Earlier20 SQL checks are a repeated subset, not additional tests.
validation.concurrency: The shared aggregate-lock call and one-lease uniqueness were reviewed in source. PGlite uses one connection; multi-session contention/race behavior was not experimentally established here.
validation.compatibility: PGlite0.5.10/PostgreSQL18.6/WASM is actual SQL/role evidence, not hosted PostgreSQL17, network authentication, TLS or real active-session cleanup proof. Historical accepted PG17 tests remain separate unaffected evidence.

permissionBoundary.permissionNeeded: Explicit approval of this reviewed additive protocol amendment and one non-renewable recovery lease for the already waiting same d002 run/job/attempt. No additional spending, provider retry, new run, new credentials, future case, budget increase or extension of original scope is proposed.

Keep full accounting/cleanup and post-d002 reassessment requirements.
